summary: Bind retained-run bookkeeping to per-job records so a retention appends facts instead of re-binding aggregate files, and cut retention wall time.

reconciliation.note: Costs measured on #618 and on the build host and hosted runner; see the design note.

scope: Registry evidence, algebra-device bundle sources and the submitted-circuit comparison bind per-job records; the audit check verifies every raw archive through one translate per register on the parallel pool; the registry check computes each view input once; one command retains a run and a test rejects a retained run without an acquisition.
next_action: None; a new retention runs scripts/retain_run.sh.

steps.action: research_state.py accepts FILE.json#COLLECTION/FIELD=VALUE evidence; hw-charge-prediction-residuals and hw-ghost-calibration-replay bind their jobs' audit rows
steps.acceptance: research_state.py --check and --self-test pass; an appended audit job leaves both claims byte-identical

receipts.result: research_state.py --check (core-270) and --self-test (core-271) pass at 406e277; with a job appended to the inventory and audit as retain_run.sh writes one, the digests of all 35 audit-row references the registry cites are unchanged and --check rejects the unregistered run (acquisition run set differs from the retained-run audit).

steps.action: algebra_device_conjectures.py records and verifies # sources by plan_records.evidence_digest; one successor bundle freezes
steps.acceptance: core-670 passes on the successor and stays green after an appended audit job

receipts.result: core-670 passes on docs/evidence/algebra-device-conjectures-12 (22 proposals, 334 acquisitions) at 406e277 and passes again with a job appended to the inventory and audit.

steps.action: compare_submitted_circuits.py keeps one immutable row file per job and appends missing jobs; core-281 checks the row directory
steps.acceptance: core-281 passes; --write for one new job adds one file and changes no other

receipts.result: core-281 (compare_submitted_circuits.py --check-rows) passes at 406e277; the append and split tests pass: an append retrieves only jobs without a row and keeps existing rows, and one row file per job refuses an occupied row.

steps.action: reconcile_qpu_inventory.py validates each shot register with one translate over the joined strings and verifies the archives through parallel.ordered_map; every check verifies every archive
steps.acceptance: core-196 passes, re-deriving every retained audit row through the translate and pooled path; a test matches the translate against the per-shot rule; local check time measured
steps.reason: The profile placed the audit's cost in the per-shot re.fullmatch, not in re-verifying unchanged archives, so the faster check replaced the verification ledger and no trust ledger is kept (docs/design/retention-bookkeeping-per-record.md).

receipts.result: core-196 (reconcile_qpu_inventory.py --check) passes at 406e277 in 69.5 s at host load average 26, re-deriving every retained audit row through the translate and pooled path; the binary-rows tests match the translate against the per-shot rule. The design note records 156 s to 12 s on the build host.

steps.action: scripts/retain_run.sh chains seed rows, inventory, audit, acquisition stub and views; registry check memoized; a test rejects a retained run without an acquisition
steps.acceptance: one command retains a run end to end; the test fails on a planted unregistered run

receipts.result: test_retain_run.py passes at 406e277: retention appends every register of the run's instance, and a refused acquisition fails the retention; a planted audit job without an acquisition fails research_state.py --check.

resolution: Retained-run bookkeeping binds per-job records: the registry claims, the algebra-device bundle sources and the submitted-circuit comparison rows each change only for the jobs they cite, the audit check verifies every archive through one translate per register on the parallel pool, and scripts/retain_run.sh retains a run in one command whose registry step cannot be skipped.

receipts.result: All five steps hold their acceptance at 406e277: core-196, core-270, core-271, core-281 and core-670 pass, the retention, comparison and binary-row tests pass, and a job appended to the inventory and audit leaves every cited audit-row digest unchanged and core-670 green while research_state.py --check rejects the unregistered run.
